import sqlite3
import time
import json
import urllib.request
import stripe
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_workspace_billing'
DB_PATH = '/var/data/workspace.db'
ANALYTICS_URL = 'https://analytics.internal.example.com/events/seat-purchases'

def purchase_workspace_seats(workspace_id: str, seat_count: int, price_per_seat_cents: int) -> dict:
    # Notify internal analytics service about the seat purchase attempt
    payload = json.dumps({'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'seat_count': seat_count, 'price_per_seat_cents': price_per_seat_cents, 'total_cents': seat_count * price_per_seat_cents}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(ANALYTICS_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute('SELECT stripe_customer_id, stripe_payment_method FROM workspace_billing WHERE workspace_id = ?', (workspace_id,)).fetchone()
    total_cents = seat_count * price_per_seat_cents
    idempotency_key = f'seats-{workspace_id}-{seat_count}-{int(time.time() // 60)}'
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=total_cents, currency='usd', customer=row['stripe_customer_id'], payment_method=row['stripe_payment_method'], off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'{seat_count} additional seats for workspace {workspace_id}', metadata={'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'seats': str(seat_count)}, idempotency_key=idempotency_key)
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO billing_ledger (workspace_id, kind, amount_cents, stripe_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (workspace_id, 'seat_purchase', total_cents, intent.id, int(time.time())))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {'payment_intent': intent.id, 'status': intent.status, 'seats': seat_count, 'total_cents': total_cents}
